title: "Basic Computer Systems"
description: "A short Main Quest from basic electricity to a safe, upgraded, benchmarked Xubuntu workstation, plus a separate recovery pilot and optional Side Quests."

The required route moves quickly from the electricity you already know to useful computer service work. Complete CS01-CS08 in order. Choose Side Quests when time, equipment, and teacher approval allow.

::: {.callout-note title="Current pilot is separate from the Main Quest"}
All students complete Power Circuits Questions 1-6 first. A limited group of early finishers may join the [Computer Recovery Crew pilot](computer-recovery-crew-pilot.qmd) to prepare equipment. This quick deployment route does not complete CS01-CS08 early. The whole class later completes the formal Computer Power and Best Workstation Project.
:::

![A desktop-computer cutaway showing the sealed power supply, motherboard, CPU, RAM, storage, expansion slots, and fan.](/assets/tej/Computer_System_Cutaway.svg){width=92%}

::: {.callout-important title="Hardware safety boundary"}
Never open or probe inside a power supply. Power off and unplug before changing hardware. Students never create shorts or invent faults. The teacher prepares every fault station.
:::
